payload.body: You tend to picture a total reinvention while remaining unsure which part of an ordinary week needs to change. Hours can go into the fantasy while the concrete dissatisfaction stays unnamed. This often comes from learning that a dream was acceptable as long as it did not become a disruptive request. Identify the specific part of your weekly routine that you actually want to change.
